goals: Add believable claimed-workplace activity while limiting Canary 1 resource-changing behavior to shepherd sheep shearing and fisherman fish catches.
Preserve output ownership and bounded storage without altering Matcha professions, trades, villager models, or vanilla global social behavior.
scope: Server-owned shepherd shearing of reachable adult regrown sheep, exact shear-output capture, and wool insertion only into face-adjacent barrels at the claimed loom.
Server-owned fisherman fish-only loot from a visible bounded cast/retrieve cycle, with output insertion only into the claimed job-site barrel.
Claimed-workstation look, hand swing, and restrained vanilla work sound for ten other professions; temporary shears/rod and an isolated fishing-float renderer.
Transient world-aware, owner-scoped path blocking for Sheep, Cow, Pig, Chicken, and Rabbit only while an active VWR task owns the physical open transition of a fence gate.

exclusions: Livestock slaughter, breeding, ranching, and simulated workstation economies.
Matcha behavior or resource-pack/model/texture/renderer changes to villagers; the fishing-float renderer is isolated to its own entity.
Global villager brain, social memory, schedule, trading, profession, or fence-gate changes; nearby item vacuum and nearest-container fallback.
Protected Matcha Flavoured 26.1.2 profile access and unowned runtime deployment.
